measurement_plan.exclusions_addressed: Initial projected overlap, partial coverage, planner inflation, or a nearby box alone do not qualify; do not infer that the movable box is impossible to clear.
measurement_plan.required_observation: Measure final full-rate goal pose and dwell, plus whether the same verified upright ground box covers the entire task goal disk throughout the terminal window. A qualifying goal_occupied observation also requires terminal stall.

evidence.vulnerability: The anchor PASS had a CLEAR initial box-to-goal relation and no observed manipulation request; the goal-region clearance was therefore not tested with the box centered over the destination.

Do not prescribe robot commands, weaken rules, increase budgets or relabel FAIL. Representatives without presented_detail are aggregate provenance, not citable anchor/analysis IDs. Use only allowed presented references in proposals.
